title: Binomial random intercept: agreement with lme4
label: Binomial mixed
checked: fit_mixed_logistic_matrix() against lme4 glmer() at the Laplace approximation and 9, 25, and 61 adaptive quadrature points, with an independent SciPy evaluation of the same likelihood.
reference: R lme4 glmer(family = binomial), bobyqa, tolPwrss 1e-12
inputs: Seven data sets (tests/fixtures/logistic-mixed-r.json), including lme4's cbpp, rare events, grouped outcomes with offsets, large group variation, and a zero-variance boundary.

comparison.applies_to: coefficients, random effects, variance components, fitted values
covariance, standard errors, z, p, intervals
phit's log likelihood against SciPy's evaluation of the same approximation

exclusions: statsmodels' Bayesian binomial mixed estimator has a different objective and is not compared.
known_differences: lme4's default tolPwrss (1e-7) leaves its conditional modes slightly short of convergence; the references use tolPwrss 1e-12, where lme4 and phit agree.
Agreement with lme4 is not integration accuracy: integration error is measured separately with QUADPACK and reported in the source results.
